question: Già prima che suo padre morisse avevo un documento dell'ufficio esecuzioni che certifica la mia perdita verso mio cugino. Col testamento il padre ha lasciato quasi tutto alla sorella e mio cugino riceve meno di quanto la legge gli garantisce, ma pur sollecitato non vuole contestarlo. Posso agire io al suo posto, entro quale termine e fino a che punto?

gold_facts.text: Creditors of an heir who held loss certificates at the time of the succession may demand reduction if the deceased exceeded the disposable portion to the heir's detriment and the heir, at their request, does not bring the reduction action.
The creditors must act within the time limit that applies to the heir.
They may demand reduction only to the extent needed to cover their claims.

competing_candidates: Civil Code rule letting creditors challenge an heir's renunciation of the inheritance (different situation: here the heir accepts but does not sue)
Civil Code articles on the reduction action itself and its time limits
note: Question states the loss certificate predates the death and that the heir was asked and refused, to match the article's conditions.

question: Possiedo obbligazioni di un prestito emesso da una società, con una garanzia reale a favore di noi creditori. L'impresa è in difficoltà e la maggioranza dei titolari vuole permettere che un nuovo finanziatore riceva una garanzia che passi davanti alla nostra. Possono deciderlo anche se io sono contrario, e quale maggioranza serve?

gold_facts.text: The rank of secured (pledge) bondholders cannot be changed without their consent.
That protection of rank is subject to the reserved power of the bondholders' community to grant priority to a new pledge.
Granting priority to a pledge created for new capital brought into the enterprise requires the consent of representatives of at least two thirds of the outstanding capital.

competing_candidates: Neighbouring Code of Obligations articles on bondholder communities: approval of such resolutions by the competent authority, and the rule for several bondholder communities
note: Answer combines the rank-protection exception in A with the two-thirds quorum and the listed measure in B.

question: Je suis actionnaire d'une petite société anonyme. Le conseil d'administration a confié la gestion courante à un directeur externe, qui a ensuite conclu des affaires désastreuses pour la société. Les administrateurs peuvent-ils dire que ce n'est pas leur faute puisqu'ils avaient délégué cette tâche, ou restent-ils responsables du dommage ?

gold_facts.text: Board members and all persons involved in management or liquidation are liable to the company and to individual shareholders and creditors for damage caused by an intentional or negligent breach of their duties.

A person who lawfully delegates a task to another body is liable for damage caused by that body unless he proves that he exercised the care required by the circumstances in selecting, instructing and supervising it.

competing_candidates: Stock company articles on a shareholder's claim for damage suffered by the company and on joint and several liability of several liable persons
Parallel liability rules for cooperatives and limited liability companies (excluded by stating a stock company)
note: Question asks only whether liability survives delegation, not who may sue or how damages are shared.

question: Unsere kleine GmbH macht pro Jahr nur etwa 60'000 Franken Umsatz und hat keine Einnahmen aus Geldanlagen. Dürfen wir im Jahresabschluss einfach die tatsächlich bezahlten und eingegangenen Beträge verbuchen, statt Rechnungen und Kosten dem Jahr zuzuordnen, in das sie wirtschaftlich gehören?

gold_facts.text: Expenses and income must be separated from each other in time and in substance.
If net proceeds from sales of goods and services or financial income do not exceed 100,000 francs, the time-based separation may be dropped and expenditure and receipts used instead.

competing_candidates: Code of Obligations rule allowing small sole proprietorships and partnerships to keep only simple income-and-expenditure accounts (excluded by making the business a limited liability company)
note: Same-language control item; avoids the article's technical terms.

question: Il proprietario mi ha disdetto l'appartamento in cui vivo da vent'anni e per la mia famiglia è molto difficile trovare un altro alloggio in zona. Se il giudice mi permette di restare ancora un po', per quanto tempo al massimo posso rimanere in totale, e posso ottenere questo rinvio più di una volta?

gold_facts.text: A residential lease can be extended by at most four years in total.
Within that maximum, one or two extensions can be granted.
If the parties agree on an extension themselves, they are not bound by any maximum duration.

competing_candidates: Code of Obligations tenancy articles on when an extension can be granted at all and on the procedure for requesting it (the question asks only about duration)

question: There is an old, privately owned stone wall along the public footpath my children take to school, and parts of it are crumbling and look like they could fall onto the path. Nothing has happened yet. Can I require the owner to make it safe before someone gets hurt?

gold_facts.text: A person threatened with damage from another person's building or structure can demand that the owner take the measures needed to avert the danger.
Orders of the police for the protection of persons and property remain reserved.

competing_candidates: Civil Code neighbour-law rules on protection against threatened damage from a landowner overstepping his property rights (weaker fit: the person threatened is a passer-by, not a neighbour)
Code of Obligations rule on the owner's liability for damage caused by a defective building (applies after damage occurs)
note: Situation set before any damage, and the asker is not a neighbouring landowner.

question: Ich bin als Zeugin in einem Zivilprozess zwischen meinem Nachbarn und seinem Vermieter vorgeladen. Worüber wird mich das Gericht befragen, und muss ich zum Beispiel auch offenlegen, dass ich mit einer der Parteien befreundet bin?

gold_facts.text: The court asks the witness to state his or her identity.
The court asks the witness to describe personal relationships with the parties and other circumstances that may affect the credibility of the testimony.
The court asks the witness to state the facts of the case that he or she observed.

competing_candidates: Civil Procedure Code article on the form of witness examination (warning to tell the truth and about penalties), which does not list what the witness is asked

question: The debt collection office seized a car that my debtor keeps in his own garage and drives alone, but his brother now claims the car belongs to him. As the creditor, can I dispute the brother's claim, how long do I have, and what does the brother then have to do to keep the car out of the proceedings?

gold_facts.text: The debtor and the creditor may contest a third party's claim at the debt enforcement office when it concerns a movable thing in the debtor's exclusive possession, and the office gives them ten days to do so.
If the third party's claim is not contested, it is treated as accepted in that enforcement.
If the claim is contested, the office gives the third party 20 days to sue the contesting party for a declaration of his right; if he does not sue, his claim is disregarded in that enforcement.

competing_candidates: Debt Enforcement and Bankruptcy Act article for the case where the third party holds the asset (excluded by stating the debtor has sole possession)
Neighbouring articles on how third-party claims are announced and on the court where the action is brought

question: I sold my holiday flat in Ticino last year for much more than I paid for it. How much tax do I owe on the profit from the sale, and can I deduct what I spent on renovating it?
trap_reason: Tax on gains from selling real estate is governed by federal tax harmonisation law and cantonal tax laws, none of which is among the eight acts, although their rules on sale of land and property look related.

question: Wie viel Gerichtskosten muss ich im Kanton Zürich ungefähr vorschiessen, wenn ich meinen früheren Geschäftspartner auf 30'000 Franken verklage?
trap_reason: The Civil Procedure Code leaves court fee tariffs to the cantons, so the amount depends on the cantonal fee ordinance, not on any of the eight acts.
